scope: Local HTML-concept implementation and verification; not formal audit or user acceptance

source_hygiene.finding: One nonfunctional trailing space in todos.js line 654 and its two generated copies. Retained in the frozen verified bytes; this is a formatting warning, not claimed as a passing whitespace gate. CRLF output format is intentional and preserved.

package_gate: Actual final ZIP tests are recorded separately in package-checks; source metadata does not self-hash its outer archive.
limitations: 60-Hz acquisition is not a steady 60-fps application-motion claim. Browser rAF gaps and long tasks are separately reported; 700-pixel restructure and large-list interactions include visible/recorded pauses.
Chromium fullscreen and download notifications appear in recordings. These are capture/browser overlays, not Puppet Master UI.

Two rawvideo thumbnail-decode commands emitted non-monotonic DTS rounding warnings. Original MKV timestamp inventories, decoded frame-hash counts and contact-sheet counts agree; no frame was padded or omitted. No inference of perfect timing is made.
Screenshots and ordinary control driving run during capture. The measurements are not an isolated performance benchmark or target-device guarantee.
Full original correction-packet wording unavailable for some historical identities. Current owner clauses were used; no exhaustive original-packet fidelity claim.
Snapshot reconstruction is in-memory only. Normal file navigation was blocked; full HTML used set_content. No durable restart, actual-origin reload or cross-host proof.
Bounded local adapters, not a general model/provider tool executor. Regular Plan stays no-ledger/no-PlanUnits; Deep Plan reuses existing scoped unit identities.
